title: Owner off-limits Hope queues (Global Router publication)
description: The Global Router publishes this JSON at <Tofu data root>/router/<owner>/HOPE_QUEUE_POLICY.json. No Tofu code writes it. Every submit path reads it again. A missing/unparsable file uses x-fail-safe-default; it never disables m17 or refuses all jobs.

projects.description: Canonical project roots to which this entry applies; omitted = all projects. Unknown callers are treated conservatively.
